profile_text.body:
DeepL is a for-profit AI company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Cologne, Germany. The company describes itself as operating an end-to-end, AI-first translation platform that handles text, files, media formats, and voice, and it offers a developer API for integration into other products. Its site states the platform is trusted by millions and delivers translation with what the company calls unbeatable quality.

The core product is a specialized large language model trained on proprietary data by thousands of language experts, which the company says enables high accuracy and personalized experiences. The platform covers translation of speech, text, and media, and the site groups these capabilities under a broader DeepL AI suite. The tracked product entry notes that DeepL's translation service is EU-hosted, which is relevant for customers with data-residency requirements.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP server registrations, or SEC records appear in the available data.
